thesis: Hold. Sizing book is one name: VTI about $251 of ~$1,001 equity (~25%), cash about $750, above the 8% floor, with room under the 45% name cap and 7-position cap. Nothing in this pack is a clear catalyst to add or rotate. Macro context is still tight: the Fed's inflation gauge rose sharply in August and the Fed hiked earlier this month, the 10-year is 5.283% and higher on the signal print, TLT is down, and WTI/USO are up about 2%. September breadth is weak (three-quarters of S&P 500 names down) even with a small index gain and an August consumer-spending rebound. Named equity items are opinions or incomplete filings: Bernstein on Celestica, a Rosenblatt note on Amazon, a Meta enterprise-tools pitch, and a mixed Lilly amylin readout that also cites more side effects. EDGAR 8-Ks (DigitalBridge change-of-control and delisting notice, Omnitek, Skyworks, and several credit vehicles) do not state terms worth trading. Citi's sell on Moderna does not apply because it is not held. Adding VTI, or opening TLT or USO, would chase the same yield and price descriptions already reflected in the book rather than a new fact.
